title: Lox cape

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Lox cape is a craftable Armor piece.
Lox cape gives resistance (0.5x) to frost.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
• Frost resist does not stack with Frost resistance mead, Yagluth power or other armor pieces.
• Frost resist will override the frost weakness from being Wet.
• Frost resist prevents Cold and Freezing effect.

full_text:
Lox cape

Internal ID: CapeLox | Type: Cape | Source: Workbench | Crafting Materials: Lox pelt x6 | Armor: 4 | Resistances: Resistant (0.5x) vs., Frost

Introduction. Lox cape is a craftable Armor piece.
Lox cape gives resistance (0.5x) to frost.

Notes. • Frost resist does not stack with Frost resistance mead, Yagluth power or other armor pieces.
• Frost resist will override the frost weakness from being Wet.
• Frost resist prevents Cold and Freezing effect.
